source_law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

source_context_review: The exact (2)(b) clause concerns exit position after intersection entry, not approach position in (2)(a). For a northbound destination, the right side of its centerline is east of the line. Measure full vehicle footprint when it leaves the intersection; do not use a center point alone.
